mapper.select: SELECT background_color AS backgroundColor, globe_glow_color AS globeGlowColor, globe_point_color AS globePointColor, globe_marker_color AS globeMarkerColor FROM user_settings WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_settings ( user_id, background_color, globe_glow_color, globe_point_color, globe_marker_color ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{backgroundColor}, #{globeGlowColor}, #{globePointColor}, #{globeMarkerColor} )
